verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog and search API for agentic commerce, so approval-gated agent spending is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only that agents can pay for API usage via MPP and that sales are attributed through affiliate buy URLs. Nothing documents a confirmation step, signed mandate, or per-purchase consent before money moves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, sensitive agent spending requires my documented approval — a confirmation step, signed mandate, or per-purchase consent — before money moves
